title: Least object of a directed tail subtype
statement: For a preorder I and i₀ : I, the subtype {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} has a least object.

proof.text: Use the subtype element (i₀, le_refl i₀); every j in the subtype satisfies i₀ ≤ j by j.property.
